headline: DJ Akademiks Drops 'Meek Speaks' Video, Sparks Zeus Network Debate
body: DJ Akademiks has posted a new Instagram video titled 'Meek speaks' with over 1,500 comments. The post, published September 4, 2026, has ignited discussion about the 'Zeus network' - a term Akademiks uses to describe his music ecosystem. The post follows a previous Instagram post with similar phrasing, suggesting ongoing engagement with his audience. With 7,739 likes, the post has become a cultural talking point in hip-hop circles.
